Name: T's Dam
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=4]Check the "Requirements".
Some mods are required ﻿and some are optional.[/size][/color]


[size=3]Access to the dam is done at the same time the railroad is released. (3 day in summer)[/size]


The features and release conditions of each map are hidden.
If you want to know quickly, click below to check it out.

[spoiler][color=#00ffff][size=3]

Explanation of each MAP, etc.[/size][/color]﻿

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Dam[/size]
[/color][size=2]There is an abundance of foraging items produced daily.
Stumps are respawned daily.
In the tent, you can end your day and save.

The minecart on this map will be available at the same time as the regular minecart are released.[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Cliff[/size][/color]
There is an abundance of foraging items produced daily.

The minecart on this map is a normal minecart release and...
Lewis's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Evelyn's friendship level is 3 or higher.
All of these conditions must be met.

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Cliff Add (Cliff(East))[/size][/color]
[size=2]Here you can grow crops.[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Cliff Add Mine[/size][/color]
[size=2]Random ores and gems are produced daily.
Each day a random item of each season's yield or weeds will be produced.

There are release conditions for this area, and it is initially sealed off.
Open conditions are...[/size]
Wizard's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Demetrius's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Willy's friendship level is 3 or higher.
All of these conditions must be met.

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Pasture Area (Dumped Farm)[/size][/color]
This area is allowed to grow grass.
Since grass does not occur naturally as in a normal farm, it is necessary to use grass starter to create seeds for some growth and spread.
Crops cannot be grown.

There are release conditions for this area, and it is initially sealed off.
Open conditions are...
Lewis's friendship level is 3 or higher.

The minecart on this map is a normal minecart release and...
Lewis's friendship level is 5 or higher.
Clint's friendship level is 3 or higher.
Marnie's friendship level is 3 or higher.
All of these conditions must be met.

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Additional elements of Pasture Area (Dumped Farm)[/size][/color]
[spoiler]You will receive an mail if the minecart in the Pasture Area is already open and if Lewis has a friendship level of 6 or higher.
Read it and construction will begin to remove the rocks at the entrance to Dumped Farm.
After a few days of construction, the "Rest Area" will be accessible.

If you go to Dumped Farm while the Rest Area is accessible and Luis' friendship level is at least 7 and Robin's friendship level is at least 5, there will be an event scene.
A few days after this event scene, Dumped Farm changes to "Restarted Farm".
The specific change is that the "House" in that location becomes available for use.
The appearance of the house can be changed in ModConfig.
The house can also contain a bed.
A mini-fridge can be placed in the kitchen to cook with the ingredients stored in it.
Outside silos, shipping bins, scattered trash, and fences will be removed.
The fixed background music outside and in the cave will be removed and replaced by the normal outdoor background music.
The yellowish effect that was applied to the entire outside map is removed, making it appear as if it were a normal outdoor scene.

After being reborn as "Restarted Farm", there is an event scene when you visit Robin's house when she is home.
The farm facilities can be built on the "Restarted Farm".
When you select Robin's construction menu, you will be given the option to choose where to build.
Animals cannot be moved between locations.

After watching the Robin event scene above, visit Marnie's house when Marnie is home and you will see the event scene.

You will receive an mail when you have already watched the Robin and Marnie event above and Lewis friendship level is 8 or higher.
A few days after reading the mail, the "House" on the "Restarted Farm" will be upgraded.
This is just an extra upgrade that adds a small second floor.

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Rest Area[/size][/color]
There is nothing remarkable about it, but you will have a high probability of picking up "Cooking Category Items" from the trash.
Many things could be installed on wide streets. (They must not obstruct the passage of cars. lol)[/spoiler]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Afforestation Area (Promenade)[/size][/color]
[size=2]There is an abundance of foraging items produced daily.
Bridges in the area have release conditions and are blocked at the beginning.
The bridge will be repaired at the same time as the mining site is liberated.[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]Dam Road[/size][/color]
There are no particularly outstanding features.
The map is intended to add realism to the distance to the dam.
If movement becomes a pain, this map can be turned off from the Mod Config.


[color=#00ffff][size=4]Other Information.[/size][/color]
The release of the warp device to Dam requires that the Wizard's friendship level be at least 5.
[/spoiler]

[size=3]It can be linked to the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14219]Desert Afforestation Area[/url]".[/size]


Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese are supported.
